# Autism Calgary

> > Autism Calgary provides employment programs, transition support, and resources for individuals with autism and developmental disabilities in Alberta.

Autism Calgary offers comprehensive services including the Spectrum Advantage employment program for young adults, guidance on transitioning to adult services (PDD, AISH, FSCD), and support for individuals with autism spectrum disorder and their families throughout Calgary and Alberta.

## Key Topics

- Spectrum Advantage
- Employment programs for autism
- Transition to adulthood
- PDD (Persons with Developmental Disabilities)
- AISH (Assured Income for the Severely Handicapped)
- FSCD (Family Support for Children with Disabilities)
- Job coaching
- Work experience programs
- Soft skills training
- Developmental disabilities support
- Guardianship
- Adult services navigation
- Autism support services
- Calgary autism resources

## Employment Programs

- [Spectrum Advantage](https://autismcalgary.com/spectrum-advantage): Employment program offering job coaching and work experience for young adults

## Transition and Adult Services

- [Transition to Adulthood](https://autismcalgary.com/transition-to-adulthood): Guide to adult services including PDD, AISH, and FSCD transition support
